tables.description: Derived daily summaries of reviewed dca-validation-metrics/1 snapshots. One record per capture, preserving partial coverage and historical counts. Reporting only; never classifies or closes validation work.

fields.name: snapshot_display_name
fields.description: Documented connector limitation: formula primary creation/type conversion unavailable. Display only; separate external *_id is authoritative.
External snapshot identity derived from metric version and captured_at; preserved across retries.
fields.name: snapshot_id

fields.description: Source observation cutoff. Does not change when imported or mirrored.
fields.name: captured_at

fields.description: True only for the latest fully verified reporting capture in this series. Earlier snapshots remain preserved.
fields.name: is_latest

fields.description: Measurement contract version; compare compatible versions only.
fields.name: metric_version

fields.description: Source coverage classification from the reviewed snapshot; partial is not organisation-wide.
fields.name: coverage

fields.description: Exact bounded population inspected by the monitor.
fields.name: scope

fields.description: Distinct bounded IDs whose reviewed state is validation_needed; held and preparation items remain included.
fields.name: validation_needed

fields.description: Subset of validation_needed with actionability actionable.
fields.name: actionable

fields.description: Subset of validation_needed held for a documented dependency.
fields.name: held_dependency

fields.description: Subset of validation_needed requiring clarification preparation.
fields.name: needs_preparation

fields.description: Subset of validation_needed whose actionability remains unknown.
fields.name: actionability_unknown

fields.description: Distinct positively established needs with a verified reconciliation gap, scoped to inspected evidence. Zero is not a DCA-wide completeness claim.
fields.name: reconciliation_pending

fields.description: Items with state unknown; excluded from both backlog headline counts.
fields.name: unclassified

fields.description: Open needs with a verified request clock.
fields.name: age_verified

fields.description: Open needs with only a conservative lower-bound clock.
fields.name: age_lower_bound

fields.description: Open needs without a supported request clock.
fields.name: age_unknown

fields.description: Maximum measured open-request age in calendar days. Read with age_basis coverage; may be only a lower bound.
fields.name: oldest_known_age_days

fields.description: Verified closures since previous snapshot, only when supplied by its reviewed comparison. Blank at baseline.
fields.name: verified_closures

fields.description: Genuinely new arrivals since previous snapshot from reviewed comparison; coverage additions are not arrivals. Blank at baseline.
fields.name: verified_new_items

fields.description: Source comparison explaining coverage, classification and closure changes. Count changes alone do not prove performance changes.
fields.name: comparison_notes

fields.description: Source limitations, coverage and pagination notes; must remain visible with interpretation.
fields.name: coverage_notes

fields.description: Private source artifact identity and captured_at locator, not a public download link.
fields.name: source_reference

fields.description: Technical record creation time; not the evidence observation time.
fields.name: created_at

fields.description: Technical last modification time; not a validation or reconciliation event.
fields.name: last_modified
capture_day
fields.description: Europe/Amsterdam calendar day derived from the source captured_at timestamp. Used as the chart category so distinct days cannot be sorted by clock time alone.

tables.name: Validation_Metric_Snapshots

tables.description: One bounded validation need observed in one reviewed snapshot. Append history; same need_id across captures. Not an independent queue, reminder system or source of operational truth.

fields.name: observation_display_name
fields.description: Documented connector limitation: formula primary creation/type conversion unavailable. Display only; separate external *_id is authoritative.
Deterministic snapshot_id + need_id import identity; deduplicate retries.
fields.name: observation_id

fields.description: External snapshot identity derived from metric version and captured_at; preserved across retries.
fields.name: snapshot_id

fields.description: Source observation cutoff. Does not change when imported or mirrored.
fields.name: captured_at

fields.description: True only for the latest fully verified reporting capture in this series. Earlier snapshots remain preserved.
fields.name: is_latest

fields.description: Original bounded need ID from the approved snapshot; do not invent identity changes.
fields.name: need_id

fields.description: Exact bounded question or finding as assessed at this capture.
fields.name: need

fields.description: Source-attributed owner wording; blank means unresolved. This does not resolve an account or authorize messaging.
fields.name: owner

fields.description:
Assessed state in the existing metric contract. Blank is invalid for accepted observations.
Options:
- validation_needed — A genuine bounded validation or clarification need remains.
- reconciliation_pending — Establishment is evidenced and a required reconciliation step demonstrably remains.
- closed — Authoritative evidence supports verified closure.
- unknown — Evidence does not support classification; exclude from headline backlog counts.
fields.name: measurement_state

fields.description:
Separate from measurement state; blank is not an inferred state.
Options:
- actionable — A supported next review action is available.
- held_dependency — A documented prerequisite or availability hold prevents the next action.
- needs_preparation — The precise clarification or review request needs preparation.
- unknown — Actionability is not established.
fields.name: actionability

fields.description:
Basis of the request clock. Not effort or lateness.
Options:
- verified — Earliest same-need request timestamp is verified.
- lower_bound — A later same-need request or bounded review task is verified; age is at least this amount.
- unknown — No supported request timestamp; age remains blank.
fields.name: age_basis

fields.description: Source-supported request clock; blank when unknown. Never use reminder, import or record modification timestamps.
fields.name: requested_at

fields.description: Elapsed calendar days from requested_at to captured_at for validation_needed only. Blank for unsupported clocks and other states; read age_basis.
fields.name: age_days

fields.description: Derived display bin, explicitly prefixed At least for lower bounds; Unknown for missing clocks. Only for open needs.
fields.name: age_band

fields.description: First exact authoritative source/review link from the snapshot.
fields.name: review_url

fields.description: All authoritative source links from the reviewed item, newline separated.
fields.name: source_references

fields.description: Exact source note and any remaining closure gap; does not change operational meaning.
fields.name: notes

fields.description: Language of the normalized measurement wording: en. Does not infer the language of original linked communication.
fields.name: source_language

fields.description: Technical record creation time; not the evidence observation time.
fields.name: created_at

fields.description: Technical last modification time; not a validation or reconciliation event.
fields.name: last_modified

tables.name: Validation_Item_Observations

tables.description: Dated, reproducible record-completeness measurements from existing operational records. One metric per source population and capture. Not stock, throughput, impact, labor time or volunteer performance.

fields.name: metric_display_name

Deterministic metric_version + captured_at + metric_key identity.

fields.name: captured_at

fields.description: Stable metric identifier in the repository reporting specification.
fields.name: metric_key

fields.description: Human-readable quantity measured.

fields.name: value

fields.name: population_count

fields.description: Exact population, numerator and exclusions; schema presence alone is not populated evidence.

fields.description: Source table URL; underlying record identities are preserved in source_record_ids.

fields.description: IDs of all records in the inspected population, for reproducibility.

fields.description: IDs counted by this metric.

fields.description: Read completeness, exclusions and interpretation limits.
